title: 第十二章 “有变化，就不是好事。“-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    ## 一、飞鸟

    三辆灰绿色的皮卡在工厂大门外五十米处停了下来。

    引擎熄火后，废土的安静重新笼罩了这片区域。林霜站在厂房顶部，弩端在手里，瞄准镜的十字线对准了第一辆车的挡风玻璃。她的手指没有放在扳机上——不是因为她不想开枪，而是因为她想先看看这些人要做什么。

    张小梅蹲在她旁边，望远镜贴在眼睛上。

    “车门开了。“张小梅低声说，“下来一个人。女的。“

    那个女人从副驾驶的位置下来，站在车门旁边，没有往前走。她穿着深灰色的作战裤和黑色的抓绒上衣，外面套着一件挂满弹匣袋和对讲机的背心。她的头发很短，几乎贴着头皮，脸型瘦削，颧骨很高，眼睛不大但目光锐利。

    她抬起头，朝厂房屋顶的方向看过来。

    不是巧合——她早就知道屋顶上有人。她的目光精准地锁定了林霜和张小梅藏身的位置，然后抬起右手，五指张开，掌心朝前，左右摇了摇。

    废土上的通用手势：停火，谈。

    “系统，扫描那个人。“

    “扫描中。目标：女性，年龄约三十五岁。生命体征正常，无明显伤病。携带武器：手枪一支（腰侧），匕首一把（小腿外侧）。战术背心中有弹匣袋和对讲机。威胁评估：中。建议保持警惕。“

    三十五岁。女人。指挥官级的装备和心理素质。

    林霜把弩放下——不是完全放下，而是从瞄准姿态转为待击姿态，枪口朝下，手指离开扳机护圈。她站起来，露出半个身体，让对方看到自己手里有武器，但不是瞄准状态。

    这个动作在废土上是一种“我可以打你，但我选择不打“的信号。

    那个女人看到了，点了下头，然后转身对车里说了句什么。三辆车的车门同时打开，下来了大约十个人——七女三男，都穿着类似的服装，都带着武器。但他们的武器配置不像收割者那样全是自动步枪，而是五花八门：猎枪、弩、砍刀、甚至还有一把用复合弓改装的远程弓。

    他们在车旁站成一排，没有散开，没有搜索，没有做任何军事上“准备进攻“的动作。只是站着，等。

    那个女人独自朝工厂大门走过来。

    张小梅从屋顶上滑下去，站在铁门后面，手握着砍刀。林霜留在屋顶上，弩的瞄准镜重新套住了那个女人的后脑勺——如果她有任何异动，从林霜扣动扳机到箭矢击中目标，只需要零点三秒。

    女人走到铁门前，停下来，抬起手，在铁门上敲了三下。

    “你好。“她的声音不大，但很清晰，隔着铁门听得一清二楚，“我是'飞鸟'车队的方晴——'飞鸟'是南边'绿洲'聚居点的侦察小队代号。我们路过这片区域，看到有人活动的痕迹，想确认一下这里是不是有幸存者。如果是，我们想问一下是否需要帮助——药品、食物、或者转移到更安全的聚居点。“

    张小梅没有开门。她贴着铁门，声音压得很低：“你们是哪部分的？“

    “废土救援队，南边来的。我们在自由集市以北五十公里处有一个聚居点，叫'绿洲'。有围墙、有农田、有医疗站。我们定期派出车队在周边搜索幸存者，把他们带到绿洲去。“

    “带过去之后呢？免费？“

    方晴嘴角扯了一下——不是客套，是被无数次问到这个问题后无奈的惯性反应。

    “不免费。到了绿洲，每个人都要劳动。种地、建设、巡逻、做手工——根据能力分配工作。劳动所得的一部分用于个人消费，一部分上缴作为公共开支。和你在任何地方生存的规则一样——不劳动，不吃饭。“

    张小梅回头看屋顶上的林霜。林霜微微点了下头。

    张小梅打开了铁门上的小门——不是大门，是一个人宽的小门。

    方晴从小门走了进来。

    她站在厂房门口的院子里，目光扫过四周——围墙上的铁丝网、墙角处削尖的木桩交叉插在地上的拒马、厂房顶部的两架固定弩——林霜用工厂废料焊的支架，射程比手持弩远一倍、地面上精心布置的陷阱痕迹。她的眼神从一开始的平静变成了惊讶，又从惊讶变成了某种更复杂的、带着打量和计算的表情。

    “这是你们建的？“她问。

    “是。“林霜从屋顶上下来，站在方晴面前。

    两个女人面对面。林霜比方晴高半个头，体型也更结实。方晴虽然套着那件挂满装备的背心，但能看出她的体型偏瘦——不是营养不良的瘦，而是长期高强度运动后的精瘦，像一只猎豹。

    “你是这里的主事人？“方晴问。

    “是。林霜。“

    “方晴。“方晴伸出手。

    林霜没有握。她的手握着弩。

    方晴把手收回去，没有尴尬，也没有生气。

    “我能看看你们的基地吗？“她问，“不是侦察，是想了解一下你们的实力。如果你们足够强，也许我们可以合作——互通有无，或者联合防御。“

    林霜看着她，沉默了三秒。

    “可以看。但不能拍照，不能画图，不能带任何东西出去。“

    “可以。“

    ## 二、参观

    林霜带着方晴在工厂里走了一圈。

    先看的是围墙。方晴用手掌拍了拍墙面——砖砌的，外面抹了水泥砂浆，厚度约三十厘米，高度两米五。她点了点头，没说话。

    再看的是陷阱区。张小梅把几处伪装揭开，露出下面的深坑、竹签阵和捕兽夹。方晴蹲下来，用手指摸了摸竹签的尖端——削得很尖，而且用火烤过，硬度很高。

    “这些陷阱能对付多少人？“方晴问。

    “看多少人。“张小梅说，“十个八个没问题。再多就不行了。“

    方晴站起来，拍了拍手上的土。

    “你们的防御思路是对的——多层次、立体化。但有一个问题。“她指向工厂北面的那片开阔地，“那边是盲区。围墙只有两米五，如果有人从北面用梯子翻墙，你们的固定弩打不到那个角度。“

    林霜看了她一眼。她说的是对的，北面那片开阔地确实是一个防御死角。但林霜还没有来得及处理——人手不够，工期排不过来。

    “谢谢提醒。“林霜说。

    接下来看的是净水器。方晴看到那个铁皮桶和塑料管组成的系统时，明显愣了一下。她蹲下来，仔细看了看每一个接口、每一层过滤材料，然后站起来。

    “这是你自己做的？“

    “是。“

    “你是工程师？“

    “当过工程兵。“

    方晴没有再问。但她的目光在净水器上停留了很久，像是在估算这个东西能值多少物资。

    最后看的是菜地。

    那片低洼地里的苗又蹿了一截。两片圆叶子展开了，中间冒出针尖大的新芽——嫩得发绿，摸一把，指尖沾点绒。方晴站在地头，看着那一片淡得几乎看不清的绿色，嘴唇微微张开。

    “在废土上种东西。“她的声音很轻，“我们也在种，但用的是大棚和营养液。露天种植，你们是第一家。“

    “这里的土壤条件还行。“林霜说，“辐射值低，土是黑的，捏一把有点黏，不酸不碱——我尝过，不涩口。“

    方晴转过身，看着林霜。

    “你知道我在想什么吗？“

    “在想怎么把我们收编到你的'绿洲'去。“

    方晴笑出了声，短促，像枪栓复位。这次是真的笑，不是无奈的惯性反应，而是一种被看穿后的、带着佩服的笑。

    “对。我想把你们全部带回去。你的工程能力，她的军事能力——“她指了指张小梅，“——这片菜地，这个净水器。你们这些人，在'绿洲'能发挥十倍的作用。“

    “但我们不会去。“林霜说。

    “为什么？'绿洲'有围墙，有上千人，有电，有真正的医院。你们这里什么都没有。十几个人，老人和孩子占了一半，粮食撑不到十天。你们能撑多久？“

    林霜看着方晴，眼神平静得像一潭死水。

    “我们不去，不是因为你那里不好。是因为我们需要自己的地盘。在别人的地盘上，永远是别人说了算。我需要一个我说了算的地方。“

    方晴沉默了几秒钟。

    “你这个人。“她说，“像是在部队里待过的。“

    “待过。“

    “我也是。XX集团军，通讯团——我在后方搞电台，你们工程兵在前线修桥。“

    林霜的眉毛动了一下。

    “XX集团军，工程兵团。“

    方晴伸出手。这次林霜握了。
    第(1/3)页

    “对。我想把你们全部带回去。你的工程能力，她的军事能力——“她指了指张小梅，“——这片菜地，这个净水器。你们这些人，在'绿洲'能发挥十倍的作用。“

    “但我们不会去。“林霜说。

    “为什么？'绿洲'有围墙，有上千人，有电，有真正的医院。你们这里什么都没有。十几个人，老人和孩子占了一半，粮食撑不到十天。你们能撑多久？“

    林霜看着方晴，眼神平静得像一潭死水。

    “我们不去，不是因为你那里不好。是因为我们需要自己的地盘。在别人的地盘上，永远是别人说了算。我需要一个我说了算的地方。“

    方晴沉默了几秒钟。

    “你这个人。“她说，“像是在部队里待过的。“

    “待过。“

    “我也是。XX集团军，通讯团——我在后方搞电台，你们工程兵在前线修桥。“

    林霜的眉毛动了一下。

    “XX集团军，工程兵团。“

    方晴伸出手。这次林霜握了。
    第(1/3)页

​ ## 1. Birds

Three gray-green pickup trucks stopped fifty meters outside the factory gate.

After the engine was turned off, the silence of the wasteland enveloped the area again.Lin Shuang stood on the top of the factory building, with the crossbow in his hand and the crosshairs of the scope pointed at the windshield of the first car.Her finger was not on the trigger—not because she didn't want to shoot, but because she wanted to see what the men were going to do first.

Zhang Xiaomei squatted next to her, the binoculars pressed against her eyes.

"The car door opened." Zhang Xiaomei whispered, "A person got out. A woman."

The woman got out of the passenger seat and stood next to the car door without moving forward.She was wearing dark gray combat pants and a black fleece top, with a vest covered with magazine pouches and a walkie-talkie.Her hair is very short, almost touching her scalp, her face is thin, her cheekbones are high, her eyes are small but sharp.

She raised her head and looked towards the roof of the factory.

It was no coincidence - she had known there was someone on the roof.Her eyes accurately locked on where Lin Shuang and Zhang Xiaomei were hiding, then she raised her right hand, spread her fingers, palm facing forward, and shook it left and right.

A common gesture in the wasteland: cease fire, talk.

"System, scan that person."

"Scanning. Target: female, about thirty-five years old. Vital signs are normal, no obvious injuries. Weapons carried: one pistol (on the side of the waist), one dagger (on the outside of the calf). There is a magazine pouch and a walkie-talkie in the tactical vest. Threat assessment: Medium. It is recommended to remain vigilant."

Thirty-five years old.woman.Commander-level equipment and psychological quality.

Lin Shuang put the crossbow down—not completely, but from the aiming position to the ready-to-fire position, with the muzzle facing down and her fingers leaving the trigger guard.She stood up and exposed half of her body, letting the other party see that she had a weapon in her hand, but it was not aiming.

This action is a signal in the wasteland of "I can hit you, but I choose not to hit you."

The woman saw it, nodded, then turned around and said something to the car.The doors of three cars opened at the same time, and about ten people got out - seven women and three men, all wearing similar clothing and carrying weapons.But their weapon configuration is not all automatic rifles like the Reapers, but a variety of types: shotguns, crossbows, machetes, and even a long-range bow modified from a compound bow.

They stood in a row next to the car and did not disperse, did not search, and did not make any military "preparation for attack" actions.Just stood and waited.

The woman walked toward the factory gate alone.

Zhang Xiaomei slid down from the roof and stood behind the iron gate, holding a machete in her hand.Lin Shuang stayed on the roof, and the crossbow's scope was put back on the back of the woman's head - if she made any movement, it would only take 0.3 seconds from Lin Shuang pulling the trigger to the arrow hitting the target.

The woman walked to the iron door, stopped, raised her hand, and knocked on the iron door three times.

"Hello." Her voice was not loud, but it was clear, and she could hear it clearly through the iron door, "I am Fang Qing from the 'Flying Bird' convoy - 'Flying Bird' is the code name of the reconnaissance team of the 'Oasis' settlement in the south. We passed by this area and saw traces of human activity, and wanted to confirm if there are survivors here. If so, we would like to ask if we need help - medicine, food, or moving to a safer settlement."

Zhang Xiaomei did not open the door.She pressed against the iron door and asked in a low voice, "Which department are you from?"

"The wasteland rescue team comes from the south. We have a settlement fifty kilometers north of the Free Market, called the Oasis. There are walls, farmland, and medical stations. We regularly send fleets to search for survivors in the surrounding area and bring them to the oasis."

"What about after you take it there? It's free?"

Fang Qing twitched the corner of her mouth - not politely, but a helpless inertial reaction after being asked this question countless times.

"It's not free. When you get to the oasis, everyone has to work. Farming, construction, patrolling, doing manual work - work is distributed according to ability. Part of the income from labor is used for personal consumption, and part is turned over as public expenditure. The same rules for your survival anywhere - no labor, no food. "

Zhang Xiaomei looked back at Lin Shuang on the roof.Lin Shuang nodded slightly.

Zhang Xiaomei opened the small door on the iron gate - not a large door, but a small door wide enough for one person.

Fang Qing walked in from the small door.

She stood in the yard at the entrance of the factory and glanced around - the barbed wire fence on the wall, the sharpened wooden stakes at the corners of the walls and the horses crossed on the ground, the two fixed crossbows on the top of the factory - the brackets that Lin Shuang welded with factory scraps, the range was twice as long as that of hand-held crossbows, and the traces of carefully placed traps on the ground.Her eyes changed from calm at first to surprise, and then from surprise to something more complex, with a look and calculation expression.

“You built this?” she asked.

"Yes." Lin Shuang came down from the roof and stood in front of Fang Qing.

The two women face each other.Lin Shuang is half a head taller than Fang Qing and has a stronger build.Although Fang Qing was wearing a vest full of equipment, it could be seen that her figure was thin - not from malnutrition, but from being lean after long-term high-intensity exercise, like a cheetah.

"Are you the person in charge here?" Fang Qing asked.

"Yes. Lin Shuang."

"Fang Qing." Fang Qing stretched out her hand.

Lin Shuang didn’t hold on.Her hand held a crossbow.

Fang Qing took her hand back, not embarrassed or angry.

"Can I see your base?" she asked, "It's not reconnaissance, but I want to know your strength. If you are strong enough, maybe we can cooperate - exchange what we have, or jointly defend."

Lin Shuang looked at her and was silent for three seconds.

"You can watch it. But you can't take pictures, draw pictures, or take anything out. "

"Okay."

​ ## 2. Visit

Lin Shuang took Fang Qing for a walk around the factory.

The first thing to look at is the wall.Fang Qing patted the wall with her palm - it was made of bricks with cement mortar on the outside, about thirty centimeters thick and two and a half meters high.She nodded and said nothing.

The next thing we look at is the trap area.Zhang Xiaomei took off several disguises, revealing the deep pit, bamboo stick array and animal trap below.Fang Qing squatted down and touched the tip of the bamboo stick with her fingers - it was sharpened and roasted with fire, making it very hard.

"How many people can these traps deal with?" Fang Qing asked.

"It depends on how many people there are." Zhang Xiaomei said, "Ten or eight is no problem. Any more will not work."

Fang Qing stood up and patted the dirt on her hands.

"Your defense idea is right - multi-layered and three-dimensional. But there is a problem." She pointed to the open space to the north of the factory, "There is a blind spot over there. The wall is only two and a half meters. If someone climbs over the wall with a ladder from the north, your fixed crossbow cannot hit that angle."

Lin Shuang glanced at her.She was right, the open space to the north was indeed a defensive blind spot.But Lin Shuang didn't have time to deal with it yet - there were not enough manpower and the construction schedule could not be scheduled.

"Thanks for the reminder." Lin Shuang said.

The next thing to look at is the water purifier.When Fang Qing saw the system composed of iron buckets and plastic pipes, she was obviously stunned.She squatted down, carefully looked at every interface and every layer of filter material, and then stood up.

"Did you do this yourself?"

"Yes."

"Are you an engineer?"

"I was an engineer."

Fang Qing didn’t ask again.But her eyes stayed on the water purifier for a long time, as if she was estimating how much material this thing was worth.

The last thing we looked at was the vegetable patch.

The seedlings in the low-lying land jumped up again.Two round leaves unfolded, and a new shoot the size of a needle emerged from the middle - so tender and green that when you touch it, your fingertips will feel a little velvet.Fang Qing stood on the ground, looking at the green that was so pale that it was almost invisible, her lips slightly opened.

"Growing things on the waste soil." Her voice was very soft, "We are also planting, but we use greenhouses and nutrient solutions. You are the first to grow in the open air."

"The soil conditions here are okay." Lin Shuang said, "The radiation value is low, the soil is black, a bit sticky when you pinch it, not acidic or alkaline - I have tasted it, and it is not astringent."

Fang Qing turned around and looked at Lin Shuang.

“Do you know what I’m thinking?”

"I'm thinking about how to incorporate us into your 'oasis'."

Fang Qing laughed out loud, briefly, like a gun being reset.This time I really laughed, not a helpless inertia reaction, but a smile with admiration after being seen through.

"Yes. I want to take you all back. Your engineering ability, her military ability -" she pointed at Zhang Xiaomei, "-this vegetable field, this water purifier. You people can play ten times the role in the 'Oasis'."

"But we won't go." Lin Shuang said.

"Why? The 'oasis' has walls, thousands of people, electricity, and a real hospital. You have nothing here. There are more than a dozen people, half of them elderly and children, and the food can't last ten days. How long can you last?"

Lin Shuang looked at Fang Qing, her eyes as calm as a pool of stagnant water.

"We won't go, not because your place is not good. It's because we need our own territory. On other people's territory, others will always have the final say. I need a place where I have the final say."

Fang Qing was silent for a few seconds.

"You," she said, "look like you have been in the army."

"Stayed."

"Me too. XX Group Army, Communications Corps - I'm working on the radio station in the rear, and your engineers are building bridges on the front."

Lin Shuang’s eyebrows moved.

"XX Group Army, Engineering Corps."

Fang Qing stretched out her hand.This time Lin Shuang got it.
